title: fix(mcp): stdio lists agent_prompt only on a boot that holds an agent (#28940)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Lw5nYyWNaPeqb4qxEBGi2P)_
Fixes #28940

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：stdio 通道的 MCP 服务器只在本次启动确实注册了 agent 时才在提示列表里列出 `agent_prompt`；参数说明里的示例名改为取自已注册的 agent，不再写死 "ask" / "build"。
- 为什么改：开源框架启动时一个 agent 都没有，客户端却能看到 `agent_prompt`，照说明填 "ask" 得到一条「成功」的提示，内容是 `Error: Agent "ask" not found`，模型会把它当指令读。
- 风险与回滚：有 agent 的启动对客户端无变化（照样列出，未命中文字逐字不变）；agent 元数据读不全时照旧列出，不把故障当成「没有」。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` 的 `bridgePrompts` 开头（是否注册的分支）与 `readAgentRoster`；`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.agent-prompt-advertised.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-server-runtime.agent-prompt-advertised.test.ts`，预期 8/8 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `bridgePrompts` (the long-lived server the stdio transport serves) reads the agent roster from the metadata service before registering `agent_prompt`, at the same moment as the existing skill snapshot:
  - **no agent, complete read**: `agent_prompt` is not registered. `prompts/list` does not carry it, a `prompts/get` on it is the SDK's own unknown-prompt error (JSON-RPC `-32602`), and one boot `info` line says why. A boot with no agent and no skill therefore advertises no `prompts` capability, which is the #8034 capability-equals-served rule.
  - **at least one agent**: registered as before. The `agentName` description draws its examples from the registered names (first two) instead of the fixed `e.g. "ask", "build"`. The served body and the miss text `Error: Agent "X" not found` are unchanged (#6055 kept that text byte-stable on purpose).
  - **degraded or thrown read**: registered as before, because an outage is not absence (the #6055 discipline). The description names no agent, and a `warn` says the roster could not be read and points at the loaders.
- `packages/mcp/README.md` Prompts section says when `agent_prompt` is listed.
- Changeset `.changeset/28940-mcp-agent-prompt-advertised.md` (`@objectstack/mcp` patch).

## Why

The same file's skill projection is built on "declared IS served": a skill that cannot be served is not listed. `agent_prompt` was the opposite shape on a boot with no agent. It was a prompt advertised where nothing can serve it, with an argument teaching two names that resolve to nothing, and a miss answered as a success.

Route check against recorded decisions (the delta asked for it):
- **#6055** (`buildAgentPromptResult` docblock): it fixed outage vs miss inside the get and kept the miss text byte-identical. Untouched. The new roster read applies the same outage-is-not-absence rule one step earlier.
- **#14461** (the old comment on the description): its concern was that the example an author copies is a canonical id, never a retired alias. Examples drawn from registered agents keep that by construction, because a registered agent's name is its id. The old `[#14461]` comment is replaced by one pointing at `agentNameArgumentDescription`, which carries the reasoning.
- **ADR-0063 §2**: `agent` is code-only, with no runtime create, so a roster read at bridge time cannot be outgrown by a runtime write.

**The two transports after this change:**
- stdio serves skill prompts, plus `agent_prompt` only on a boot holding an agent.
- HTTP (`/api/v1/mcp`, `handleHttpRequest` → `registerSkillPrompts`) serves skill prompts only and never `agent_prompt`. That is unchanged.

On a boot with no agent, the open-framework case the card measured, the two transports now agree.

## Tests

- New `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.agent-prompt-advertised.test.ts`, 8 cases over the real wire (an in-memory transport into the same `McpServer` the stdio transport attaches to). **Red first** on unmodified code: 7/8 failed, and each failure was the defect itself (`expected [ 'agent_prompt', 'case_management' ] to not include 'agent_prompt'`; a get on the no-agent boot returned `Error: Agent "ask" not found` as a result; the description read `(e.g. "ask"…`; `capabilities.prompts` was `{ listChanged: true }` with nothing to list). The 8th case, served body plus byte-stable miss, is the preservation pin and passes on both trees.
- **Forced test edits** (named per the order):
  - `packages/mcp/src/mcp-stdio-tools.test.ts`, the #8034 "bridged server" double: `list` now returns one agent for `agent`. That test asserts the assembly really serves all three primitives. Its double held no agent and no skill, so after this change it would serve no prompts.
  - `packages/mcp/src/__tests__/mcp-server-runtime.test.ts`, "survives a metadata service that cannot list skills": its replacement `list` kept answering `[]` for `agent`. It now keeps the double's agents, because the case is about the skill read alone.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run`: 54 files, 652/652 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per negative pin, each restored with a blob-hash match)</summary>

Every mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor hit once, the replacement landed, then a restore). The suite imports `./mcp-server-runtime.js` from source, so no dist rebuild was involved. After the run, `git diff HEAD` was empty and the file blob was back at `09f63b589939`.

- A1, withholding disabled (`if (roster.state === 'none' && false)`) turned 4 red: no-agent list, get is `-32602`, boot line, no-capability case.
- A2, the fixed `e.g. "ask", "build"` description put back turned 2 red: agents-boot description and degraded description.
- A3, the degraded branch deleted (a degraded empty read becomes `none`) turned 1 red: degraded keeps the prompt.
- A4, a thrown read mapped to `none` turned 1 red: throw keeps the prompt.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- With agents registered, stdio lists `agent_prompt` and HTTP still does not. That divergence predates this card and is not in its acceptance. Noted, not filed.
- The roster is a snapshot taken at MCP plugin `start()`, beside the skill snapshot. An agent provider that registers after that point in the same boot would leave `agent_prompt` withheld on stdio until restart. No such provider exists in this repository (no open package registers an agent). Whether a cloud host registers its platform agents later than `start()` cannot be measured from here, and the stdio transport is a local-host surface. Raised as an open question in the report, not worked around.

## Verification

All readings at head `9126fc31`.

<details><summary>Derived gate list and lint</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 59 commands. On the first sweep 56 exited 0. Three exited 3 because a prerequisite was missing, which is NOT MEASURED, not a pass:
  - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed its pinned positive-control commit. After `git fetch origin 621a4876…` it exited 0 (48 cases).
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` read built output. After a full `pnpm build` (117/117 tasks) both exited 0. `pnpm check:dts-closure` was rerun on the same build and exited 0 (293/293 declaration files present).
- `--ran` reconciliation: 59 derived, 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Not in the derived list but run anyway: `pnpm check:startup-registry-verdict` exited 0, reporting none recording a verdict the boot can contradict.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, whole repo) printed no diagnostic. The four changed `.ts` files linted alone also exited 0.

</details>
